sss.identity: Round-1 base_sss_cifar10 rows; i is the canonical NATS-SSS index

tss.identity: Round-1 base_tss_cifar10 rows joined to the locked index-to-architecture-string map

aznas.adapter: SSS only: expose the same stem-and-cell feature list already exposed by the official TSS model; no network layer or metric equation is changed
aznas.aggregate: Within each space, sum log(rank/n) for cached official FLOPs, expressivity, progressivity, and trainability; average ties
aznas.batch: one fixed label-free 64x3x32x32 standard-normal tensor per seed, reused for every architecture in both spaces

bootstrap.resampling_unit: architecture identity within a search space

identity_gate: actual torch parameter count must match Round-1 cached params*1e6 within the cache's half-parameter rounding tolerance
primary_target: cached CIFAR-10 test accuracy in percent
secondary_target: cached CIFAR-10 validation accuracy in percent
sign_stability_definition: TSS and SSS point-estimate Spearman correlations have the same non-zero sign; this is not a universality claim

swap.batch: the first 16 CIFAR-10 training images in official order, official SWAP normalization, labels unused
swap.initialization: official iid unit-normal Conv2d/Linear weights, BN weight 1 and bias 0
swap.seeds: 0 through 31, reset explicitly for every architecture/repeat
